operationPlan: Open controlled design with openDesign({type:'all_pages'}) where supported.
Create supported GA elements using unique probe content markers.
Reorder elements through ElementList list operations.
For dropTarget, verify Path media editability and mediaContainer behavior; replacement UI/asset operation must be observed separately.
For Autofill, use only a controlled tagged design and record field labels/types; Preview mapping creation is a separate research-only probe.
Normalize source/target representation and produce semantic diff.

acceptance.positive: Every claimed GA-native semantic must survive create/read/update/read-back with expected values and hierarchy.
acceptance.deletion: Probe-created disposable element must disappear after delete and remain absent on read-back.
acceptance.ordering: List order must match requested moveBefore/moveAfter operation.
acceptance.identity: PageId stability must be observed. Element identity must be recorded only if the actual GA runtime exposes it.
acceptance.strictNegative: Unsupported/document-gap semantics must not be silently flattened and must be marked unsupported/unknown.
